incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — svc/inference-queue backlog (P1). trigger: inference-queue > backlog_threshold for 3m. page: pd-12345.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page pd-12345 created. summary: inference queue depth 46k, sustained 8k r/s ingest. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> oncall-senior.

aj_oncall: acked. I'm oncall — jumping in. Who has the latest queue/scale view? :eyes:

maria_dev: I'm pulling dashboards. Quick note: hosted API error spike ~14% 5xx in the last 10m, a subset of customers are seeing timeouts/503s when tail latency > 6s.

leo_ops: metric snapshot: queue depth = 46,200 (tokens waiting). throughput in = 7.9k req/s. avg token wait = 1.2s (headroom gone). autoscaler events show repeated scaleUp attempts but nodes not provisioning:
```
Event: scale-up failed (provisioner): instance create error: quotaExceeded -> "CPUs per region"
autoscaler: attempted 8 nodes in last 6m, 0 successful
```

kevin_infra: I see the same in infra logs. Cloud provider returning 403 QuotaExceeded on instance create. Also a couple of API 429s from provider controlplane. Looks like a sudden quota/soft-limit hit in us-central1.

maria_dev: ok — manual mitigation options: 1) spin up nodes in a different zone/region (if autoscaler supports mixing); 2) manual node create with existing image, attach to cluster; 3) temporarily route small/cheap model variants for non-enterprise customers to reduce token pressure. Thoughts?

leo_ops: I'll try manual node create in us-east1 and add to pool. Command (starting):
```
gcloud compute instances create rwinf-temp-1 --zone=us-east1-b --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --image=redwood-inference-runtime-v2 --metadata=cluster=prod
```
I'll monitor join.

pagerduty-bot: Alert pd-12345 acknowledged by aj_oncall. Escalation paused.

aj_oncall: thanks leo. maria — can you flip fallback routing for non-paid traffic to model-lite? Use runtime flag route_fallback=small-latency. That should cut pressure quickly.

maria_dev: doing a small canary flip now (non-paid traffic only). Command: `redwoodctl route set --service inference --variant model-lite --filter "plan==free" --dry-run=false`

sre_sara: seeing events — new node rwinf-temp-1 starting, kubelet registering... cluster autoscaler still failing in us-central1 but fallback and manual node are helping. queue depth -> 28,900 (6m after action). 5xx rate down from 14% -> 6%. Good signal but still elevated.

kevin_infra: quick root-cause update: our automated infra batch (nightly image builds) consumed a soft quota bump earlier; cloud provider didn't honor our request for temporary quota while we were spinning. Filed a support ticket (cloud-sup-9988) and requested emergency quota increase. ETA unknown. We should avoid cross-region burst until we confirm.

leo_ops: manual node join completed. New node pooled and accepting pods. Added 4 additional smaller nodes (n1-standard-8) as hotfix.

aj_oncall: nice. monitor for 15m. If queue keeps falling to <5k and 5xx <1%, we'll close. Also draft a short status note for status.redwood.com — minimal customer-facing: "We observed elevated latency and errors on hosted inference due to capacity provisioning delays; routing fallbacks and manual capacity added; mitigation in progress." Anyone want to edit?

maria_dev: suggest adding ETA: "We expect further improvements within 30–45 minutes; we'll update if things change."

sre_sara: metrics update (12m): queue = 14,300. error rate = 2.1%. token latency p50 -> 65ms, p95 -> 1.8s. Some long-tail still present for ongoing sessions.

pagerduty-bot: pd-12345 escalated to kevin_infra (senior) due to quota error code.

kevin_infra: I'm on it. digging into provider logs and quota history. Noting root cause and adding mitigation plan: 1) provider quota request escalation; 2) enable cross-region fallback for autoscaler as permanent safety; 3) adjust nightly jobs to avoid peak windows.

leo_ops: sent a short status to #customer-ops with the draft. They asked for an ID to reference — assigning INC-2026-041.

aj_oncall: thanks. I'll hand off in 30m to ron_next_oncall — keep watching until queue <5k and errors ~0.5%. ron, flag if you need escalation to infra.

ron_next_oncall: taking handoff at +30. I'll be primary for the next hour. Current snapshot: queue=9,700, error=1.1%, provision ticket=cloud-sup-9988 open. If queue doesn't trend down below 5k in next 45m, re-run node add or consider temporarily restricting burst tokens for PLG free tier.

maria_dev: created status post draft in #customer-ops and pushed to ops->status for QA.

kevin_infra: cloud provider replied: provisional quota increase granted (temp 20 CPUs) — applying. Should help autoscaler attempts.

sre_sara: final check before handoff: queue 4,600, 5xx ~0.4%. latency tails improving. Recommend close after 15m stable.

aj_oncall: closing page plan: if stable for 15m, close pd-12345 and mark INC-2026-041 as mitigated; keep the follow-up action item for infra: "autoscaler fail-safe: cross-region fallback + quota monitoring".

ron_next_oncall: acknowledged. I'll keep watch and post final close when stable. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: pd-12345 awaiting close (open).
